description:
A long time ago, in a galaxy not so far away (just down I-35)… 🌌
May the Fourth be with you, Central Texas. Whether you're scouting a moisture farm in Killeen, dodging Imperial traffic on 35, or just trying to find a home with a closet big enough for your lightsaber collection — today's the day to celebrate.
Drop your favorite Star Wars quote below. Best one gets all my respect (and possibly the high ground). ⚔️
